_comment: Blog & script writing (#130, BlogWriterScreen) + Document scanner/organiser (#29, DocScannerScreen) — ADVANCED, §21. New ARB keys {key:[bn,en]} to merge into app_bn.arb/app_en.arb at next sync. Both screens are KEY-GATED mocks: a deterministic template scaffold (AI full-draft is key-gated via Integrations `anthropic`) and a manual document organiser (OCR auto-read is key-gated via Integrations `ocr`). ZERO Bangla literals live in .dart — every string below is an AppLocalizations getter. REUSED existing getters (NOT re-emitted): copy, copied, save, delete, cancel, retry, loadFailed, saveFailed, commonDeleted, camera, gallery. ৳ not used here. bw* = blog writer (39 keys), ds* = doc scanner (28 keys). Total 67.

dsOcrLockedBody: একটি OCR কি যুক্ত করলে (সেটিংস → ইন্টিগ্রেশন → OCR) ছবি থেকে লেখা নিজে থেকে পড়া যাবে। কি ছাড়া ডকুমেন্ট হাতে গুছিয়ে রাখা যায়।
